name: maybe_Ui_ObjectList_BuildEntries
signature: void maybe_Ui_ObjectList_BuildEntries(UiObjectList* self, const unsigned char* entries, const unsigned char* end)
summary: Builds one 0x220-byte draw object per 2-byte entry of a caller-supplied descriptor array and appends it to the list at self+4 (count at +0x84). Every entry gets an atlas/variant id from the per-category lookup (func_00668954(self, 0..9)), a sub-index of (entryCount % 5) and the position (0, 0, 125 - 5*index), with the shared 16-byte sprite descriptor (0x0E/0x10 header, scale 1.0, 0.3, alpha 0xFF). The exact screen/subsystem is not proven; the object shape and the 5-column index strongly suggest an icon/sprite list.
evidence: loop advances 2 bytes per entry and switches on the entry code 0..0x0B; func_00668954(self, 0..9) returns the per-category id; the (count % 5) computation uses the /5 magic 0xCCCCCCCD and is only applied to some categories, while categories 3/4/5 force 0/1/2; positions from g_005d224c (0x7E7030, zero vector) and the 125.0/5.0 literals; 0x3997E8 creates the object from the 16-byte descriptor, 0x1235A4 appends it to obj+0x194, 0x5F5F54 sets the transform through 0x614B98/0x573144 (2D sprite transform). Called by the three-way window updater 0x5E3ACC (which builds three parallel sub-lists at +0x1570/+0x1D7C/+0x1FDC; 0x668BBC validates all three), and by 0x5E4580. Earlier assumption "font glyph quads" was rejected: the neighbouring 0x5D0714 is a sprite-from-descriptor helper, not a font primitive.

name: maybe_Ui_ObjectList_Clear
signature: void maybe_Ui_ObjectList_Clear(UiObjectList* self)
summary: Releases every object appended by maybe_Ui_ObjectList_BuildEntries and resets the count: it walks self+4..self+4+4*count and calls func_001C7570(heap, object) on each, then sets self+0x84 = 0. Uses the lazily created shared UI heap object (0x7BE300, vtable 0x782950).
evidence: same caller set and field layout as 0x5D19B8 (count at +0x84, objects at +4..); calls func_001C7570(*(heap+8)+0x54, self+4+i*4) for each entry then self->f_84 = 0; lazy heap flag pair 0x7BE2FC/0x7BE300 with 0x7F52B8 matches the other Ui list code.

signature: void maybe_Effect_SpawnOrientedInstance(EffectOwner* owner, EffectRequest* req)

Recovered entry point with no direct callers (invoked through a stored function pointer).
evidence: only callee with a name is 0x35FF3C maybe_Effect_FindOrCreateInstance(*(puVar6[2]+0x60), req->f_3a, 0, &params); heavy sqrt/quaternion basis maths at 0x005E54B8; func_00633C38/func_00633DCC resolve a locator id to a transform; the 0xE0-byte param block matches the Effect emit params used by 0x35FF3C callers; status = recovered entry (no prologue callers found).

name: maybe_Sound_StreamPlayer_StartLocked

signature: void* Field_ObjectFactory_Type1362(void* ctx, void* owner, u16 typeId, int is2D)
